title: Blothera
description: A Survival Overhaul Experience. Powered by 25+ custom-built in-house plugins.
body:
![blotheralogo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e875f2b440a9c0bf24aa4550a1fc78dc66f4b528_0.webp)

_A Survival Overhaul Experience_

**Powered by 25+ custom-built in-house plugins.**

No pay-to-win • No kits • No teleport spam • No coordinates

Just survival, strategy, and a player-shaped world.

## ❤ Hardcore-lite
Blothera features a custom Hardcore-Lite system:
- Each death removes a Max Heart
- Max Heart can be restored through Golden Apples or sleeping near a campfire
- Health Regeneration from full hunger is disabled.
- Use suspicious stews, potions, golden apples and sleep to heal.


## 🧭 Real Exploration
The world is meant to be discovered.
- Coordinates disabled
- Navigation via maps and compasses
- Banners act as spawn points
- Expeditions require planning, supplies, and outposts.


## 🐄 Harder Survival
Survival systems are rebalanced:
- Crops require sunlight
- Animals must breed under open sky
- Overcrowding causes disease
- Progression requires multi-structure exploration


## 🚂 Chunk-loading Trains
Build real transportation networks:
- Link minecarts into physics-based trains
- Transport cargo and players
- Trade over long distances with active chunk-loading


## 🌑 Bloodmoon Nights
Every few weeks, the sky turns red.
- Powerful Blood Monsters spawn
- They appear even in well-lit areas
- They can hear you. Sneak to avoid detection.


## 🐀 Alignment
Features a custom alignment system:
- Killing players will cause alignment loss
- Low alignment = suspicious or bandit status
- Gain alignment by killing bandits
- Bandits can not join nations and are KOS
- Capture bandits with chains and drag them to your prison with leads
The decision is yours. Play by the law of nations, or choose a life of banditry.


## 🏰 Player Nations
To form a nation, you must first defeat the Ender Dragon.
- Govern using books and lecterns
- All actions are recorded as historical records
- Form alliances or wage war
- Siege towns with cannons and airships
Power comes from leadership, infrastructure, and survival.


## 📜 Your Story
You begin near a ruined settlement on a vast continent.

Will you build a nation, map the unknown, create a railway empire…
or become something feared?
